ic_name: MIPI D-PHY / CSI-2 (TI SLLA414 application note)

protocol_overview.type: Source-synchronous, half-duplex (per lane), packet-based serial protocol stack. D-PHY (physical layer) + CSI-2 (protocol layer).
protocol_overview.duplex: half-duplex per lane; Data Lanes carry source→sink HS payload but allow source↔sink LP escape (e.g. ULPS).
protocol_overview.dual_mode_signaling: HS (high-speed terminated differential 100-200 mV) + LP (low-power single-ended 1.2 V CMOS); share same wires.
protocol_overview.DDR_clock: Both edges of Clock Lane latch one bit per Data Lane; Data-rate = 2 × Clock-Lane-frequency.
protocol_overview.controller_role: Source (image sensor / display panel side) drives all HS payload; both ends can initiate LP escape.
protocol_overview.target_role: Sink (application processor) receives HS payload, decodes CSI-2 packets, may participate in LP escape (e.g. acknowledge ULPS exit).

functional_requirements.text: D-PHY shall use exactly 1 Clock Lane + N Data Lanes, N ∈ {1,2,3,4}. Each lane is a single differential pair (Dp/Dn).
HS mode: differential terminated signaling, 100-200 mV swing, 100 Ω differential termination, 80 Mbps to 1.5 Gbps per lane (D-PHY v1.2 raises ceiling to 2.5 Gbps).
LP mode: single-ended 1.2 V CMOS signaling, unterminated, ≤ 10 Mbps; used for control / escape / Stop state.
Clock Lane is DDR — both rising and falling edges of Clock Lane latch one bit on each Data Lane. Data-rate (per lane) = 2 × Clock-Lane Hz.
Lane states: LP-00, LP-01, LP-10, LP-11 (Stop), HS-0, HS-1. LP-11 = idle (Stop state).
HS Entry sequence: LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS-0 (zero, called HS-Zero state) → Sync pattern 8'b00011101 → HS payload.
HS Exit sequence: HS payload → HS-Trail (last bit held one bit-period longer) → LP-11 (return to Stop state).
LP Escape Entry sequence: LP-11 → LP-10 → LP-00 → LP-00 Escape Mode pattern. Used for ULPS (Ultra-Low Power State), Trigger, Reset.
CSI-2 protocol layer is packet-based: Long Packet (4-byte header DI + WC[15:0] + ECC[7:0] + payload + 2-byte CRC-16 footer) and Short Packet (4-byte DI + Data[15:0] + ECC[7:0], no payload).

Data Identifier byte DI = VC[7:6] (Virtual Channel) + DT[5:0] (Data Type). VC = 0..3 (D-PHY v1.1) or 0..15 (v1.2+). DT enumerates RAW6/7/8/10/12/14, YUV420/422-8/10, RGB444/555/565/666/888, generic 8-bit, and sync short-packet types FS/FE/LS/LE.
Header ECC is extended Hamming(8,4): single-bit-error correct + double-bit-error detect over the 24-bit DI+WC (or DI+Data) header.
Long-Packet payload checksum is CRC-16 polynomial 0x1021 (x^16+x^12+x^5+1), initial value 0xFFFF, MSB-first, computed over payload bytes only (not header).
Sync pattern for HS payload entry is 8'b00011101 (LSB-first on the wire = 10111000).
Frame sync uses Short Packets: FS (Frame Start, DT=0x00) → line {LS (Line Start, DT=0x02) → Long Packet payload → LE (Line End, DT=0x03)} × N_lines → FE (Frame End, DT=0x01).
Up to 4 (D-PHY v1.1) or 16 (v1.2+) Virtual Channels time-multiplexed on the same physical lanes; each VC carries an independent stream.
When N_data_lanes > 1, payload bytes are interleaved across lanes (byte 0 → lane 0, byte 1 → lane 1, ..., byte N → lane 0, ...).

Named D-PHY timing parameters: T-LPX (LP transmit length), T-HS-PREPARE (driver settle), T-HS-ZERO (HS-Zero state length), T-HS-TRAIL (trailing bit hold), T-EOT (end-of-transmission), T-CLK-PRE / T-CLK-POST (clock relative to data).

configurations.name: 1 Data Lane
configurations.description: Smallest config: 1 Clock Lane + 1 Data Lane. Single byte stream.

configurations.name: 2 Data Lanes
configurations.description: 1 Clock Lane + 2 Data Lanes interleaved byte 0/byte 1.

configurations.name: 4 Data Lanes
configurations.description: Maximum: 1 Clock Lane + 4 Data Lanes; 4 × per-lane bandwidth.

error_response_conditions: Header ECC single-bit error — corrected silently.
Header ECC double-bit error — packet dropped, error reported.
Payload CRC-16 mismatch — packet payload flagged but length still respected (per WC).
Sync-pattern miss — HS receiver fails to lock; data is lost until next HS Entry.
LP-Contention — both source and sink drive conflicting LP states simultaneously.
T-HS-* timing violation — receiver may sample incorrect bits; per-lane bit error.
Lane-skew exceeding tolerance — multi-lane payload misaligned at receiver.
compliance_requirements: HS swing 100-200 mV differential; LP swing 1.2 V single-ended.
DDR Clock Lane: both edges of CLK_P/CLK_N produce one Data-Lane bit each.
Sync pattern 8'b00011101 (LSB-first on the wire) must immediately precede HS payload.
Header ECC = extended Hamming(8,4) — must correct 1 bit, detect 2.
Stop state = LP-11 ≥ T-LPX after every HS / Escape burst.
Multi-lane: byte 0 → lane 0, byte 1 → lane 1, ..., byte N → lane (N mod N_lanes); inter-pair skew ≤ 100 ps.
